issues.description: The problem statement and UML require public getters for each Lecture attribute, but the solution implementation declares getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() as private. This visibility mismatch would prevent students or tests (which expect public getters) from accessing these values and may cause tests to fail or confuse students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public so that all getters are public and match the problem specification and UML. Update both the template and solution implementations accordingly (e.g., 'public String getLectureName()' and 'public int getNumberOfInscribedStudents()').
